rationale: A 3-trading-day cooldown can reselect the same symbol before a fixed 5BD evaluation position has exited. It may reduce concentration but does not establish a strict one-position-per-symbol 5BD policy.

interpretation.cooldown_3: partial diversification / possible re-entry or pyramiding diagnostic only; cannot qualify the current family as a strict Stable★6 replacement candidate
interpretation.cooldown_5: strict no-overlap candidate for D+1-open -> D+5-close evaluation; may qualify if frozen gates pass

development_eligibility: DEV next-open mean >= 80% of cooldown0 DEV baseline
DEV max-symbol share <= 75% of cooldown0 DEV baseline share
strict_policy.if_dev_ineligible: STRICT_NO_OVERLAP_FAIL; do not open 5-day H2 outcome
strict_policy.if_dev_eligible: Evaluate exactly the 5-day policy on H2, even if the original 3/5 chooser prefers 3 days. Use the validation-blind Top-K pool so nonchosen H2 outcomes remain unopened until this rule authorizes the 5-day evaluation.

failure_action: No post-hoc cooldown/TopK/threshold/ATR/model/session/tie-break tuning on H2. Demote strict replacement claim; continuation/re-entry specialist may remain.
restrictions: Do not treat cooldown3 as strict no-overlap evidence.
Do not open cooldown5 H2 if its DEV eligibility fails.
